name: zotero-live-cite
description: Autocomplete \cite{} keys straight from your running Zotero library, and add each chosen reference to your .bib file.

commands.title: Zotero Live Cite: Select Collection to Search

zoteroLiveCite.libraryUrl.markdownDescription: Zotero local API URL of the library to search. The default is your personal library; use `http://127.0.0.1:23119/api/groups/<groupID>` for a group library.

zoteroLiveCite.collection.markdownDescription: Zotero collection to search, with its subcollections. Accepts a name (`Thesis`), a path (`Reading List/Transformers`) or a collection key. Leave empty to search the whole library. Set it with **Zotero Live Cite: Select Collection to Search**.

zoteroLiveCite.bibFile.markdownDescription: `.bib` file that chosen references are added to, relative to the workspace folder. Leave empty to use the workspace's only `.bib` file (you are asked once if there are several).
